# Capability & Entitlement Requirements Checklist: Self-Service Onboarding

**Purpose**: Unit tests for English — validate the quality, clarity, and completeness of the capability/entitlement requirements before planning
**Created**: 2026-10-02
**Feature**: specs/013-self-service-onboarding/spec.md

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are both boolean capabilities and numeric limits/quotas defined with evaluation rules, not just named as supported? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are requirements specified for how the single capability evaluation point is consumed by onboarding, dashboard, and server checks alike? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is the centralized capability matrix schema specified with its per-feature fields (supported types, optional/recommended status, entitlement reference, default state)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK004 - Is "effective capability" defined as a testable combination rule (type support AND entitlement allowance AND configuration) without vague conjunction? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is "full access to everything the platform already offers" bounded by an enumerable feature set or reference instead of an open-ended phrase? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-023 + Clarifications 2026-10-02]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is "evaluated live, not permanently copied" specified with re-evaluation triggers and staleness criteria? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK007 - Are capability source-of-truth requirements consistent between the business-type profile (Spec §FR-008, §FR-015) and the centralized matrix authority (Spec §FR-021)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008 vs §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK008 - Do the profile's relevant/optional capability fields align with the matrix without duplicate or conflicting definitions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015 vs §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is the business-type ≠ plan distinction preserved consistently across profiles, entitlements, and dashboard visibility rules? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015 vs §FR-023 vs §FR-024]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK010 - Can the adversarial capability criterion (hidden UI plus direct-request rejection plus live re-evaluation) be objectively determined from the requirements? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK011 - Are re-evaluation acceptance conditions specified for entitlement change (trigger events and expected access delta)? [Gap, Spec §FR-019]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK012 - Are capability requirements defined for the zero-product business state (what an empty catalog can show and do)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011 + Clarifications 2026-10-02]
- [ ] CHK013 - Are default-capability requirements specified for the "other" fallback business type? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-004 + Clarifications 2026-10-02]
- [ ] CHK014 - Are capability-exposure requirements defined for incomplete (draft-state) businesses created early in the wizard? [Coverage, Spec §FR-003 vs §FR-009 + Clarifications 2026-10-02]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK015 - Are forged client plan/capability/identity claim scenarios addressed as requirements (ignore claim, derive server-side) for every gated operation? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-020 + §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK016 - Are numeric-limit boundary requirements defined (at-limit versus over-limit behavior, e.g. product creation)? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-018]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK017 - Is the "no commercial numbers, prices, or tiers" boundary stated as a requirement constraint on matrix contents? [Dependency, Spec §FR-023 + Explicit out-of-scope]
- [ ] CHK018 - Are the future subscription contract assumptions (trial-start/end, plan, expiry attachment points) documented as requirements rather than narrative? [Assumption, Spec §FR-022 + Dependencies]

## Notes

- Scope per reviewer answers 2026-10-02 (Q1:C capability/entitlement only; Q2:D all three risk angles gated; Q3:A lightweight pre-plan gate, 18 items).
